summary_md: **了不起的阿斗 ([@ZLH_Adou](https://x.com/ZLH_Adou/status/2115877209500270715))** shares **OpenVideoHarness**, a video workbench for Claude Code and Codex: ask for a film in one sentence and the agent writes code that renders every frame, self-checks and pauses at three points for sign-off ([ZLHad/OpenVideoHarness](https://github.com/ZLHad/OpenVideoHarness)).

relevance: Harness specialized for code-driven video with human checkpoints.
